question: In MS - Word, a document may be printed using ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl+P**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Ctrl+P is the short key used to print a document in MS Word.**
 
• Print Preview in MS Word is used to View how the document will appear when printed.
 
• Print preview refers to formatting a document for the printer.
 
• Print preview is commonly called preview or previewing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Ctrl + C (Copy)**

 
 
• **​**Copies the selected text, image, or object to the clipboard.
 
• When you press **Ctrl + C**, the selected content remains in its original location, but a copy is stored in the clipboard.
 
• This allows you to paste it elsewhere without affecting the original content.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + X** (Cut)
 
 
• Cuts the selected text, image, or object and moves it to the clipboard.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + V** (Paste)
 
 
• Pastes the content from the clipboard to the current cursor location
